description: Cross-atom extension of the GAP-A-3 binding flat-baseline/overshoot analysis (D, 3He, 4He). For each atom: A(K) (Phase-4 derived), tr_M(beta_K) (canonical y_lambda_at q0 + chi_all_lambda), flat baseline A*tr_M vs -B/m_e, overshoot factor, and bar-mix (max|w_lambda - w_lambda^T|). No fit; no P_lambda proposed.

trends.overshoot_vs_A: GROWS monotonically 2.05 -> 2.86 -> 3.36 (atom-dependent; deuteron ~2x is NOT universal)
trends.overshoot_over_A: 1.02, 0.95, 0.84 (decreasing => NOT overshoot=A; sub-linear; no closed form fitted)
trends.bar_mix_vs_A: SHRINKS 0.189 -> 0.072 -> 0.016 (flat trace more bar-symmetric for heavier atoms)

verdict: The binding overshoot is atom-DEPENDENT (grows with A); the deuteron ~2x is D-specific, not universal. So P_lambda must carry an A-GROWING net suppression and an A-SHRINKING bar-symmetrisation. Rules out constant P_lambda, atom-independent scalar suppression, and any universal factor-1/2. The productive P_lambda must have explicit A-dependence. No P_lambda proposed; no fit.
critical_distance: A(K) carries A's <=2.5% uncertainty (steep exponents, possible compounding); the monotone overshoot trend is far larger than that noise and robust, but precise values carry the A-uncertainty.
discipline: No fit; no 7th ansatz; no P_lambda proposed; nothing wired; c_k/Delta_lambda cal-anchored.
